new_series.title: This City Is Ours
new_series.synopsis: Michael and Diana have barely arrived in their Spanish happy town when they are dragged back into the fold to answer questions around Ricardo’s death.

new_series.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
new_series.synopsis: Four famous faces paired with a friend or a loved one must tackle the most formidable race yet - traversing the ancient jungles and indigenous heartlands of Borneo to the southern tip of Australia.

new_series.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
new_series.synopsis: Paul and Bob are joined by terrier Ted, sadly for the final time, to fish the River Ribble in Lancashire. They are hoping to catch barbel, and Ted hopes to taste Bob’s hotpot.

new_series.title: Escaping Idi Amin
new_series.synopsis: In 1972, Ugandan dictator Idi Amin announces a plan to throw all Asians out of the country within 90 days. Will they be able to flee on their British passports?

new_series.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
new_series.synopsis: Professor Hannah Fry explores the promises and threats of AI, considering the ways in which superintelligent machines can help humanity as well as the ways in which they can be a hindrance.

new_series.title: The Traitors Ireland
new_series.synopsis: Siobhán McSweeney welcomes a group of strangers to Slane Castle to play the ultimate murder mystery game. Siobhán picks her Traitors, but this time, there’s a twist that causes immediate confusion.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: A new adaptation celebrating the 300th anniversary of Jonathan Swift’s satire. Shipwrecked in Lilliput, Gulliver is first a giant among tiny people, then a curiosity among giants.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Every UK government says it wants  strong and sustained economic growth. But for almost 20 years none have managed it. Ben Chu asks why generating growth seems so difficult?

new_series.title: Lingo
new_series.synopsis: Adil Ray hosts as twin sisters Dee and Noreen, married couple Tom and Kyle, and siblings Bobby and Beena compete in the fast-paced game of words.
